_comment: product-candidate-provider rules. The engine consumes this file and never hardcodes a mapping, threshold or vocabulary.

reject_reason_codes.PRODUCT_TYPE_MISMATCH: 产品类型与解决策略要求的类型不一致
reject_reason_codes.COVERAGE_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: 产品保障方向与解决策略指定的方向不匹配
reject_reason_codes.ELIGIBILITY_INELIGIBLE: 客户不符合产品投保条件
reject_reason_codes.ELIGIBILITY_UNKNOWN: 客户投保资格所需信息不足，无法判定
reject_reason_codes.EVIDENCE_MISSING: 产品存在但缺少对应知识证据，不得作为有依据的推荐
reject_reason_codes.PRODUCT_NOT_IN_CATALOG: 产品不存在于 Product Catalog

next_information_needed_by_reason.ELIGIBILITY_UNKNOWN: 补充客户年龄与职业类别
next_information_needed_by_reason.EVIDENCE_MISSING: 补充对应险种的知识库证据或明确该结论无证据支撑
next_information_needed_by_reason.PRODUCT_TYPE_MISMATCH: 确认保障缺口所属险种，或扩充 Product Catalog
next_information_needed_by_reason.COVERAGE_DIRECTION_MISMATCH: 明确解决策略的保障方向关键词

no_candidates_guidance.detail: Product Catalog 中没有任何产品覆盖该解决策略要求的险种与保障方向
no_candidates_guidance.needed: 确认保障缺口所属险种与保障方向，或在 Product Catalog 中补充对应产品；在补齐前不得硬凑最接近的产品
